headline: Microsoft 365 outage disrupts Outlook, Teams and Copilot worldwide
summary: Multiple Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams and Copilot, went down worldwide. Microsoft attributed the disruption to elevated load on a portion of its infrastructure across multiple regions, and reports of the outage began dropping as Microsoft restarted affected servers.

claims.statement: Multiple Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams and Copilot, experienced a worldwide outage.
